.

이번 타이밍 놓치면 아쉬운 이벤트예요 😋
(20일 수요일은 휴무입니다!)

상품권 증정 이벤트도 함께 진행되고

카메라, 음향기기, 노트북, PC, 조립PC, 드론까지

.

오래 사용하는 가전제품일수록
오프라인 구매 메리트 확실히 느껴져요 🔧
.
4층에는 예식장까지 있어서
대구 사람들한테는 익숙한 랜드마크 느낌도 있는 곳이에요 ✨
.

snippet.description:

#들안길 #서민갈비
.
오랜 시간 사랑받아온 곳답게
규모부터 남다른데 1, 2층 합쳐 500평이라 모임이나
가족외식으로도 많이 찾는 곳이에요 😋
.
요즘은 흔한 숙성고기가
여기는 숙성이라는 말도 익숙하지 않던 시절부터

.

전문 교육 받은 직원들이 쉐프복 입고 그릴링해줘서
더 편하게 즐길 수 있어요 👨 🍳🔥
.
돼지갈비는 달짝지근한 양념에
부드러운 육질이 잘 어우러지고
숯불향까지 더해져 계속 손 가는 맛이에요 🥩
.
같이 먹는 전복뚝배기도 별미인데
작은 성게까지 들어가 있어서
국물에서 해물 풍미가 진하게 느껴져요 🌊
.
솥밥 주문하면 된장찌개도 함께 나오는데
여기에도 해산물이 푸짐하게 들어가서
식사 마무리까지 든든한 구성이에요 🍲
.

.

id.title: Saya dengar semua orang di Daegu mengenal Seomin Galbi.
id.description:
Restoran tradisional berusia 35 tahun yang tidak boleh Anda lewatkan jika ingin menikmati iga babi Daegu 🍖🔥

#Deuranjil #SeominGalbi

.

Sesuai dengan popularitasnya yang telah lama, ukurannya luar biasa; dengan luas 500 pyeong (sekitar 1.650 hektar) yang mencakup lantai pertama dan kedua, tempat ini menjadi tempat populer untuk berkumpul dan acara keluarga 😋

.

Meskipun daging yang diawetkan sudah umum saat ini, mereka mengatakan tempat ini menawarkan gaya asli, karena telah mengawetkan daging mereka sendiri sejak zaman ketika istilah "pengawetan" bahkan belum dikenal 👍

.

Staf akan memanggang daging untuk Anda; karyawan yang terlatih secara profesional mengenakan seragam koki untuk memanggang, sehingga semakin nyaman untuk dinikmati 👨 🍳🔥

.

Iga babi ini memiliki cita rasa yang membuat Anda ingin kembali lagi, dengan bumbu marinasi manis yang berpadu sempurna dengan daging yang empuk dan aroma arang yang khas 🥩

.

Sup abalon yang disajikan bersama juga merupakan hidangan istimewa; bahkan mengandung landak laut kecil, memberikan cita rasa makanan laut yang kaya pada kuahnya 🌊

. Jika Anda memesan nasi yang dimasak dalam panci, sup pasta kedelai akan disajikan bersama nasi tersebut,

dan sup ini kaya akan makanan laut,

sehingga menjadi hidangan yang mengenyangkan hingga akhir 🍲

.

🏬 Seomin Galbi

🚩 8-5, Deuran-ro, Suseong-gu, Daegu

.

#RestoranDaegu #RestoranDeurangil #RestoranIgaBabiDaegu

en-US.title: I heard that everyone in Daegu knows Seomin Galbi.
en-US.description:
A 35-year-old traditional restaurant that you can't miss when it comes to Daegu pork ribs 🍖🔥

#Deuranjil #SeominGalbi

.

True to its long-standing popularity, the scale is exceptional; with 500 pyeong (approx. 1,650 acres) across the first and second floors combined, it is a popular spot for gatherings and family outings 😋

.

While aged meat is common these days, they say this place offers the original style, having aged their meat in-house since a time when the term "aging" wasn't even familiar 👍

.

The staff grill the meat for you; professionally trained employees wear chef uniforms to do the grilling, making it even more comfortable to enjoy 👨 🍳🔥

.
The pork ribs are a flavor that keeps you coming back for more, with the sweet marinade blending perfectly with the tender meat and the added charcoal aroma 🥩

.

The abalone stew served alongside is also a delicacy; it even contains small sea urchins, giving the broth a rich seafood flavor 🌊

. If you order the rice cooked in a pot, soybean paste stew comes with it,

and it is generously filled with seafood,

making for a hearty meal right to the finish 🍲

.

🏬 Seomin Galbi

🚩 8-5, Deuran-ro, Suseong-gu, Daegu

.

테무는 ‘로컬 셀러 프로그램’을 통해 국내 다양한 로컬 기업들의 성장을 지원하고 있는데요.
합리적인 가격 경쟁력과 ‘발견형 쇼핑’ 구조를 기반으로, 국내 판매자들이 더 많은 고객과 연결될 수 있도록 돕고 소비자와 판매자 모두에게 실질적인 가치를 제공하는 플랫폼을 지향하고 있습니다.

셰프애찬 역시 테무 입점 이후 '청양 멸치 만능된장' 등 대표 상품이 큰 인기를 얻으며 새로운 성장 기회를 만들어가고 있다고 합니다.

en-US.description:
#DongDaeguStationRestaurant famous for being the ultimate value for money

#AmiAmi and #Minjun appeared at #Bamsaeuneundak Sincheon Branch

.

The Half-and-Half Set has arrived!

A generous visual that surprises you the moment you see the portion size 😳

This is the Bamsaeundak enjoyed with half seasoned and half soy sauce.

.

Since it comes pre-cooked,

you can eat it right away after cooking it just a little more on the grill,

so it's great to enjoy without waiting 🔥

.

They use domestic chilled meat,

and at 29,000 won for 600g,

the quantity and quality are definitely worth the price 💸

.

The moment you cut into it, the juices come alive,

and it's so tender and moist that you just can't stop eating it 😋

.

The steamed egg is served one per person,

so it's a great point to be able to eat comfortably without feeling self-conscious 👍

.

You can enjoy a variety of special cuts, including

chicken neck meat, cartilage, and even skirt steak.

The textures are all different, so it's fun to pick and choose what you want to eat 🐔

.

To finish off, add a bento box,

and shake it up to eat

and you've got a hearty meal complete 🍱

.

🏬 Bamsaeuneundak Sincheon Branch
